messages:
pat: Quick follow-up from the midnight canary wobble. We need a short list of follow-ups: hotfix for max rollout size, a POC auto-rollback, and tighter warmup checks. Keeping this thread for owners and dates.

nina: +1. I started a short doc in the tracker. We should prioritize the hotfix so we don't repeat user-facing flaps.

michael: I'll take the hotfix for limiting blast radius. Proposed default: 8% traffic, 1-region, and block ramps >20% without manual approval. Can push today as a config fallback.

ops-bot: incident summary: canary p95/p99 spike correlated with cache-miss storm at 01:12 UTC. Automatic ramp continued for 6 mins before manual pause.

pat: exact ask for auto-rollback POC: implement a lightweight decision service that consumes metric streams + eval webhooks, outputs a rollback token. Requirements: require 2 independent signals, cooldown 45m, dry-run option, and audit logs.

eng-oncall: note on recurring pattern: several incidents in last 60 days show model cold-start + KV miss cascade when ramp hits >5% in a new region. Suggest adding region-level warmup gating that checks key hit-rate and model-init-time before traffic.

ux-anne: for Console we need a clear "safety" section on rollout config: max_blast, regions_allowed, auto_rollback_enabled, and a visible history of decisions with one-line reason. I'll mock by EOD.

nina: costs/ops note: auto-rollback should not be enabled by default for enterprise Dedicated customers without consent. We'll add a per-tenant opt-in flag.

michael: hotfix plan: add a global server-side default `rollout.max_percent` env var and a pre-ramp check that ensures requested percent <= env. I'll open PR ENGINF-701 now. Hotfix target: 2026-03-29.

pat: POC timeline: decision service MVP by 2026-04-12, integration tests by 2026-04-19, runbook update by 2026-04-26. Can someone own the decision schema?

eng-oncall: I'll draft the minimal schema. Suggest fields: signals[], require_signals, cooldown_s, dry_run, manual_override_users, audit_channel. Example YAML:

```
# minimal rollback decision schema
signals:
  - name: error_rate
    mode: multiplier
    threshold: 2.5
    window_s: 300
  - name: p99_latency
    mode: absolute_ms
    threshold: 1800
    window_s: 300
require_signals: 2
cooldown_s: 2700
dry_run: true
manual_override_roles: [platform_admin, oncall]
audit_channel: eng-platform
```

pat: nice. Add an `eval_score_threshold` too so we can plug in our diff-eval webhook for output regressions. Set default 0.75.

ops-bot: deploy note: canary ramp paused by eng-oncall at 1820004800 during manual intervention.

nina: actionable list (short):
- ENGINF-701: server-side blast-radius cap hotfix 7 owner: michael 7 due: 2026-03-29
- ENGINF-702: rollback-decision service POC 7 owner: pat 7 due: 2026-04-12
- ENGINF-703: Console safety UX + opt-in flags 7 owner: ux-anne 7 due: 2026-04-09
- ENGINF-704: region warmup gating & KV hit checks 7 owner: eng-oncall 7 due: 2026-04-07
- ENGINF-705: telemetry + rollback audit events schema 7 owner: nina 7 due: 2026-04-15

pat: let's make ENGINF-701 a hotfix priority. michael, once your PR is up ping #eng-platform and add a short test that simulates a new-region ramp.

michael: will do. PR should have CI + a unit test mocking traffic control.

ux-anne: Console mock will show an inline "safety score" and a link to the last rollback event. We'll also add a small banner when auto-rollback is enabled.

eng-oncall: operational runbook note: when rollback triggers, dispatch a one-liner summary to the audit channel with run_id, signals, and affected rollout id. Include a link to the decision trace for debugging.

nina: scheduling: quick sync Thurs 30min to review POC wiring + UX. Invite outgoing.

pat: thanks everyone. Final asks: update tracker tickets with PR links, and append live signal logs to ENGINF-705 when available. I'll follow up next week.
